limitations: Published, upcoming and cancelled filters are separately captured and must not be added as disjoint totals.
Breakdown categories can overlap; pagination uses breakdown.total only.
Completeness is confined to the returned filtered catalogue; not all ONS data or website content.
The live index is not transactionally frozen; stable counts cannot exclude equal-count substitutions.
Only selected metadata is retained; no observations or download payloads are requested.
Contact fields and unreviewed nested content are excluded from the public projection.
Release dates do not establish statistical observation periods; native representations are not merged.
coverage.unit: ONS release URI within the explicit date window and type filter

date_changes.change_notice: Due to LFS reweighting, we have decided to cancel the Annual Multi-Factor Productivity publication until we are able to publish using the LFS reweighted data. The next publication will be in May 2025. Please contact the productivity team for further information at [contact omitted]

Our estimates of multi-factor productivity (MFP) are official statistics in development. As part of our detailed quality assurance processes, we have decided to postpone this upcoming release planned for 27 November 2025 to ensure inputs to this calculation, for example, the Volume Index of Capital Services are quality assured in detail. This will also allow us additional quality assurance to assess the coherence of MFP against related indicators.
This release has been postponed to 28 May 2026 to provide extra time for quality assurance.
